products: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana, the open visualization layer for metrics, logs, traces, and related telemetry, plus a commercial cloud and enterprise business on the same projects. Grafana Cloud is a managed, OpenTelemetry-native observability platform (metrics, logs, traces, profiles, IRM, RUM, synthetics) with Adaptive Telemetry for cost control and a Knowledge Graph for cross-stack root cause. The OSS LGTM stack is Loki (logs), Grafana, Tempo (traces), and Mimir (Prometheus-compatible metrics); related projects include Pyroscope, k6, Alloy, Faro, and Beyla. Self-managed Grafana Enterprise, Bring Your Own Cloud, and Grafana Federal Cloud (FedRAMP High / DoD IL5) cover regulated and on-prem buyers. 2026 product push is agentic operations: Grafana Assistant, Investigations, Workspace, Automations, a Grafana Cloud MCP server, the gcx CLI, and Agent Observability went GA in July. Grafana 13 shipped at GrafanaCON in Barcelona in April, with a next-gen Loki architecture and the Logline acquisition for high-cardinality log search. CEO/co-founder Raj Dutt; CTO Tom Wilkie; co-founder/CGO Torkel Ödegaard. Competitors: Datadog, Splunk, New Relic, Elastic, Dynatrace, Honeycomb, Chronosphere.
fiscal_outlook: Private. Grafana-announced figures: more than $400M ARR and 7,000+ customers as of 2025-09-30 (up from $250M ARR and 5,000+ customers in August 2024). Boilerplate now cites 35M+ users; named customers include Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce. Last company-announced financing was a September 2025 secondary led by Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan, with Sapphire Ventures and Tiger Global joining Lightspeed, Sequoia, GIC, Coatue, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. That followed an August 2024 Series D extension of about $270M at a valuation over $6B. Aggregators (CB Insights, PitchBook, Tracxn) report a ~$250M Series E around Feb–Mar 2026 at a ~$9B valuation; Grafana has not published a matching release, so treat that round as unconfirmed. Third-party S-1/IPO-timing claims are inconsistent and unverified. Headcount in current JDs is 1,600+ across 40+ countries (press still said 1,400+ in early 2026). March 2026: five-year AWS strategic collaboration. Gartner Leader in the 2026 Magic Quadrant for Observability Platforms. No confirmed company-wide layoff; Blind “silent exit” posts are anecdotal only.
hiring_trends: Greenhouse showed 146 jobs on 2026-08-23, almost all remote and duplicated by country, so unique reqs are far fewer. Roughly 95 listings are engineering-like; about 45 include “Staff.” Active themes: AI/ML and agent infrastructure (Staff AI Engineer on Grafana AI/ML; Second Horizon skunkworks for enterprise-agent context/MCP), Cloud Observability fullstack (TypeScript/React + Go + Jsonnet integrations), Adaptive Telemetry databases, Tempo/Loki/Pyroscope backends, Grafana Enterprise, platform/metal (mostly EMEA), identity, and alerting. Org narrative is observability for the agentic era: Assistant and MCP, OpenTelemetry, Adaptive Telemetry cost control, and turning Tempo/Loki into platforms other Grafana AI products consume. US/Canada Staff IC hiring is live; many senior backend and platform seats are EMEA-only. Careers: 100% remote, outcomes not hours, optional $175/month coworking stipend.
similar_role_hires: Open US/Canada reqs that match Staff/Lead, senior fullstack, platform, or LLM product eng: Senior FullStack Engineer, Grafana Cloud Observability, US remote (Cloud Integrations; TS/React + Go + Jsonnet; US/Canada EST only — a real constraint from Denver MST); Staff AI Engineer, Grafana AI/ML, USA (LLM/agent incident workflows); Staff AI Engineer, US (Marketing Operations agents — weaker product-eng fit); Staff Software Engineer, Adaptive Telemetry Databases, USA; Staff Backend Engineer, Second Horizon, US or Canada except Quebec (greenfield AI-native context layer, MCP); Staff Backend Engineer, Databases Tempo, US/Canada; Staff Backend Engineer, Grafana Enterprise, US/Canada; Staff Software Engineer, Platform Application Core Services, US (control plane; posted US base about $174,986–$209,983). Senior fullstack US posted base $154,445–$185,334. Public “just hired” names for these exact reqs were not found. Several Staff Tempo/SRE/identity roles are EMEA-only.
hiring_profile: High-signal ATS: long, specific JDs (roadmap, SLOs, on-call, OSS, posted US bands), updated through July–August 2026 — not thin spam. Ghost-job risk is moderate because the same req is cloned five-plus times by country, which inflates the 146-job headline. Unique US Staff/senior IC seats look real. Bar is Staff-heavy: systems design, Go or a credible path to Go, Kubernetes, written async across time zones. Closest title to a TS/React + platform profile is Cloud Integrations fullstack, but it is EST-gated and Go on the backend. Staff AI/ML and Second Horizon fit LLM product eng better than classic fullstack. Interview (Grafana eng blogs): recruiter, hiring manager, practical coding or take-home (not puzzle LeetCode; AI coding tools allowed on take-homes), then non-abstract large-scale design; they aim to decide within two business days of the final. Junior/mid roles are scarce. Truly remote, but region and timezone locks are strict.
